        labelSpend: 'prototype defaults to local deterministic interactions; --labels workflow --workspace prepares local operations without dispatch and consumes their verified results; --labels 12ui explicitly enables one hosted label call per screen',
        precedence: 'deterministic navigation applies; dropdowns bind only from three or more distinct labeled options',
        hardGates: ['branch.plan.json', 'semantic viewport section ids or verified local-page identity'],
    },
};

FILE versions/0.2.130/node_modules/@12ui/design/dist/cli-draft-command.js
import { readFile, stat } from 'node:fs/promises';
import path from 'node:path';
import { TwelveUiBranchClient, } from './branch-client.js';
import { booleanFlag, stringFlag } from './cli-arguments.js';
import { CliRefusal } from './cli-refusal.js';
import { usageRefusal } from './cli-usage.js';
import { createLongRunningProgress, nextActionLine, secondsSince, } from './cli-progress.js';
import { readConversionConfig } from './config.js';
import { INSPIRATION_ATTEMPT_FILE } from './cli-corpus-types.js';
import { TwelveUiCorpusClient } from './corpus-client.js';
import { acquireDraftRunDirectory, } from './draft-adoption.js';
import { draftLocalRunKey } from './draft-identity.js';
import { draftPaths, readDraftRecord, writeDraftCompletion, } from './draft-workspace.js';
import { DRAFT_CANDIDATE_COUNT, DRAFT_CANDIDATE_COUNT_MAXIMUM, DRAFT_CANDIDATE_COUNT_MINIMUM, DRAFT_CORPUS_MODE_FLAG, parseDraftCorpusMode, draftReferenceRetrieval, prepareDraftRun, } from './draft-run.js';
import { assertReferenceSearchServable } from './reference-search-mode.js';
import { readDraftConcept, readDraftCorpusQuery } from './draft-corpus-query.js';
import { loadCorpusReferenceImage } from './cli-corpus-reference-image.js';
import { DEFAULT_DRAFT_REFERENCE_RETAIN, DRAFT_LAYOUT_RETAIN, draftRetainIdentity, draftRetainsLayout, parseDraftRetainFlag, } from './draft-retain.js';
import { IMPROVE_RETAIN_ALL_KEPT_REFUSAL, improveRetainKeepsEverything, } from './improve-concept.js';
import { dispatchHostedDraftSlots, downloadHostedDraftCandidates, hostedDraftRunIsSettled, HOSTED_DRAFT_CANDIDATE_DURATION_SECONDS, HostedDraftFailureError, summarizeHostedDraftRun, waitForHostedDraftRun, } from './hosted-draft-run.js';
import { finishDraftDispatchAttempt, startDraftDispatchAttempt, } from './draft-dispatch-attempt.js';
/** `12ui draft` owns corpus retrieval, the hosted run, and local image materialization. */
/**
 * A draft is the CLI's primitive for redesign, improve and branch work, never the first round of a user choosing among
 * new designs: that is the Design workspace started from the brief, whose first round is twelve options each drawn from
 * its own sketch (workspace-start.ts). Measured 2026-10-10 (sketches-first-round): agents followed this answer's earlier
 * "the Design workspace comes first" to a draft first round in 11 of 11 product sessions, so no session showed a sketch.
 */
export const CHOOSING_STARTS_FROM_BRIEF = 'A user choosing among new designs starts from the brief: design.slate.create where the workspace shows in the conversation (the Codex app), else `12ui workspace open --concept "<brief>" --wait`.';
const parseMode = (flags, hasSource) => {
    const mode = stringFlag(flags, 'mode')?.trim();
    if (!hasSource) {
        if (mode)
            throw new Error('--mode applies to a redesign; pass --redesign-source with it');
        return 'new-interface';
    }
    if (mode === undefined || mode === 'exploratory')
        return 'exploratory-redesign';
    if (mode === 'reskin')
        return 'structure-preserving-reskin';
    throw new Error('--mode must be exploratory or reskin');
};
const parseAspect = (flags) => {
    const aspect = stringFlag(flags, 'aspect')?.trim();
    if (aspect === undefined)
        return 'landscape';
    if (aspect === 'landscape' || aspect === 'portrait' || aspect === 'square')
        return aspect;
    throw new Error('--aspect must be landscape, portrait, or square');
};
/** Undocumented legacy alias, normalized to a public profile before every hosted call. */
const DRAFT_IMAGE_MODEL_FLAG = '--image-model';
/** Customer-facing Draft tier. */
export const DRAFT_IMAGE_PROFILE_FLAG = '--profile';
const parseProfile = (value) => {
    if (value === 'standard' || value === 'pro')
        return value;
    throw new Error('--profile must be standard or pro.');
};
const legacyProfileFor = (value) => {
    if (value === 'flare')
        return 'standard';
    if (value === 'sunburst')
        return 'pro';
    throw new Error('--image-model must name a supported legacy Draft profile.');
};
const parseDraftImageProfile = (flags) => {
    const profile = stringFlag(flags, 'profile')?.trim();
    const legacyModel = stringFlag(flags, 'image-model')?.trim();
    const selectedProfile = profile === undefined ? undefined : parseProfile(profile);
    const selectedLegacyProfile = legacyModel === undefined
        ? undefined
        : legacyProfileFor(legacyModel);
    if (selectedProfile && selectedLegacyProfile && selectedProfile !== selectedLegacyProfile) {
        throw new Error('--profile and --image-model choose different Draft profiles.');
    }
    return selectedProfile ?? selectedLegacyProfile ?? 'standard';
};
const rejectLocalProviderFlags = (flags) => {
    const retired = ['provider', 'project-root'].filter((flag) => flags[flag] !== undefined);
    if (retired.length > 0) {
        throw new Error(`${retired.map((flag) => `--${flag}`).join(', ')} retired from 12ui draft.`
            + ' Draft image generation is hosted and authenticates only to 12ui.');
    }
};
/**
 * The build route, offered once, for a reference a person handed to `12ui draft`.
 *
 * It is wrong advice inside `12ui improve`: that reference is improve's own
 * screenshot of the page being improved, so it is ALWAYS a finished design, and
 * converting the screenshot rebuilds the interface the run exists to replace.
 * Improve suppresses it with `referenceFromCapture`; `12ui draft` still prints
 * it on every reference.
 */
export const redesignRouteNotice = (source) => (`\`${source}\` is already a finished design. To build it rather than redraw it:`
    + ` \`12ui convert ${source} --output html\`. Continuing with a redesign draft.`);
const readCandidateCount = (flags) => {
    const value = stringFlag(flags, 'candidates');
    if (value === undefined)
        return DRAFT_CANDIDATE_COUNT;
    const count = Number(value);
    if (!Number.isSafeInteger(count)
        || count < DRAFT_CANDIDATE_COUNT_MINIMUM
        || count > DRAFT_CANDIDATE_COUNT_MAXIMUM) {
        throw new Error(`--candidates must be an integer between ${DRAFT_CANDIDATE_COUNT_MINIMUM}`
            + ` and ${DRAFT_CANDIDATE_COUNT_MAXIMUM}`);
    }
    return count;
};
const preparedFromRecord = (args) => {
    const paths = draftPaths(args.record.runDir);
    return {
        runDir: paths.runDir,
        recordPath: paths.draftRecord,
        runId: args.record.hosted.runId,
        candidateCount: args.record.hosted.candidates.length,
        adopted: args.adopted,
        runKey: args.runKey,
        record: args.record,
        nextAction: nextActionLine({
            what: `${args.record.hosted.candidates.length} hosted draft candidates`,
            typicalSeconds: HOSTED_DRAFT_CANDIDATE_DURATION_SECONDS,
            statusCommand: `12ui next ${paths.runDir}`,
            waitHint: `or run \`12ui next ${paths.runDir} --wait\` to collect in this shell`,
        }),
    };
};
/** Claim one corpus set and exactly one hosted run, then persist the resumable handle. */
export const prepareDraftCommand = async (flags, dependencies = {}) => {
    dependencies.progress?.update({ stage: 'prepare', detail: 'validating draft inputs' });
    rejectLocalProviderFlags(flags);
    const conceptValue = stringFlag(flags, 'concept');
    if (!conceptValue?.trim()) {
        throw usageRefusal({
            reason: 'A draft starts from the design problem in words, and --concept was not given.',
            code: 'draft_usage',
            verb: ['draft'],
        });
    }
    const query = readDraftConcept(flags);
    const candidateCount = readCandidateCount(flags);
    const corpusMode = parseDraftCorpusMode(stringFlag(flags, 'corpus-mode'));
    const plannedDraft = dependencies.plannedDraft;
    const write = dependencies.write ?? ((line) => { process.stdout.write(`${line}\n`); });
    const warn = dependencies.warn ?? ((line) => { process.stderr.write(`${line}\n`); });
    const referenceInput = stringFlag(flags, 'reference');
    const redesignSourceInput = stringFlag(flags, 'redesign-source');
    const referenceFlag = referenceInput?.trim();
    const redesignSourceFlag = redesignSourceInput?.trim();
    if (referenceInput !== undefined && !referenceFlag) {
        throw new Error('--reference requires a path or URL');
    }
    if (redesignSourceInput !== undefined && !redesignSourceFlag) {
        throw new Error('--redesign-source requires a path or URL');
    }
    if (referenceInput !== undefined && redesignSourceInput !== undefined) {
        throw new Error('Pass one of --reference or --redesign-source, not both');
    }
    const sourceFlag = referenceFlag ?? redesignSourceFlag;
    // Beside the flags it arbitrates between, and before anything is claimed,
    // loaded, or bought: an explicit hedge against a reference image is a mode
    // the corpus will not serve, so it refuses here rather than 400ing after the
    // caller has been shown a run directory. `runDraftCommand` runs the same
    // assertion once more before it prints the paid brief.
    assertReferenceSearchServable({
        mode: corpusMode,
        referenceImage: Boolean(sourceFlag),
        flag: DRAFT_CORPUS_MODE_FLAG,
    });
    const requestedMode = parseMode(flags, Boolean(sourceFlag));
    const retainInput = stringFlag(flags, 'retain');
    const retainFlag = retainInput?.trim();
    if (retainInput !== undefined && !sourceFlag) {
        throw new Error('--retain requires --reference');
    }
    if (plannedDraft && !sourceFlag) {
        throw new Error('A planned draft requires its captured reference image.');
    }
    if (plannedDraft && retainInput !== undefined) {
        throw new Error('A planned draft uses the retained policy from its durable redesign plan.');
    }
    // WHAT THE REFERENCE IS. `--retain` says what to hold; this says what it is
    // being held FROM, because an exclusion means opposite things against a
    // design the caller liked and against the caller's own page. `12ui improve`
    // replays its draft stage through this command, so without it every improve
    // draft would reach the model as "do not reuse its actual content or text".
    const retainSourceFlag = stringFlag(flags, 'retain-source')?.trim();
    if (retainSourceFlag !== undefined && retainSourceFlag !== 'inspiration' && retainSourceFlag !== 'subject') {
        throw new Error('--retain-source must be inspiration or subject');
    }
    const retainSource = retainSourceFlag === 'subject' ? 'subject' : undefined;
    const baseRetain = plannedDraft
        ? plannedDraft.retain
        : sourceFlag
            ? retainInput !== undefined
                ? parseDraftRetainFlag(retainFlag ?? '')
                : requestedMode === 'structure-preserving-reskin'
                    ? DRAFT_LAYOUT_RETAIN
                    : DEFAULT_DRAFT_REFERENCE_RETAIN
            : null;
    const retain = baseRetain && retainSource
        ? { ...baseRetain, source: retainSource }
        : baseRetain;
    // AT LEAST ONE FACET MUST BE FREE, and only against the caller's OWN page
    // (owner, 2026-09-02). An inspiration reference is a design they liked, and
    // "take all of it" is a coherent request there; a subject run with nothing
    // free asks an image edit to return its input. `12ui improve` replays its
    // draft stage through this command, so it is refused in both spellings, and
    // before the hosted run is started.
    if (retain && retainSource === 'subject' && improveRetainKeepsEverything(retain)) {
        throw new Error(IMPROVE_RETAIN_ALL_KEPT_REFUSAL);
    }
    const mode = !sourceFlag
        ? 'new-interface'
        : draftRetainsLayout(retain)
            ? 'structure-preserving-reskin'
            : 'exploratory-redesign';
    const corpusQuery = await readDraftCorpusQuery(flags, query, plannedDraft?.corpusQuery);
    const retrieval = draftReferenceRetrieval({ override: corpusMode, candidateCount, query: corpusQuery, referenceImage: Boolean(sourceFlag) });
    if (retrieval.adjustment && !dependencies.corpusAdjustmentReported)
        warn(retrieval.adjustment.reason);
    const aspect = parseAspect(flags);
    const imageProfile = parseDraftImageProfile(flags);
    const redesignSource = sourceFlag
        ? await (async () => {
            const loaded = await loadCorpusReferenceImage(sourceFlag, undefined, {
                label: referenceFlag ? '--reference' : '--redesign-source',
            });
            return {
                path: loaded.evidence.sourcePath,
                sha256: loaded.evidence.sha256,
                evidence: loaded.evidence,
                input: loaded.input,
            };
        })()
        : undefined;
    if (redesignSource && !dependencies.referenceFromCapture)
        warn(redesignRouteNotice(sourceFlag));
    const pageRoute = dependencies.pageRoute?.trim();
    const runKey = draftLocalRunKey({
        query,
        corpusQuery,
        candidateCount,
        redesignSourceSha256: redesignSource?.sha256 ?? null,
        aspect,
        mode,
        retainIdentity: draftRetainIdentity(retain),
        ...(corpusMode ? { corpusMode } : {}),
        ...(retrieval.adjustment ? { corpusAdjustedMode: retrieval.mode } : {}),
        imageProfile,
        ...(pageRoute ? { pageRoute } : {}),
        ...(dependencies.redrawGeneration && dependencies.redrawGeneration > 0
            ? { redrawGeneration: dependencies.redrawGeneration }
            : {}),
    });
    const config = (dependencies.readConfig ?? readConversionConfig)({
        origin: stringFlag(flags, 'origin'),
        apiKey: stringFlag(flags, 'api-key'),
    });
    const { paths, adopted } = await acquireDraftRunDirectory({
        query,
        runKey,
        ...(dependencies.workspaceRoot ? { root: dependencies.workspaceRoot } : {}),
    });
    write(paths.runDir);
    dependencies.onRunDirectory?.(paths.runDir);
    const existing = adopted ? await readDraftRecord(paths.draftRecord) : undefined;
    if (existing?.version === 2)
        return preparedFromRecord({ record: existing, adopted, runKey });
    const corpusClient = (dependencies.createCorpusClient
        ?? ((value) => new TwelveUiCorpusClient(value)))(config);
    const hostedClient = (dependencies.createHostedClient
        ?? ((value) => new TwelveUiBranchClient(value)))(config);
    dependencies.progress?.update({
        stage: 'retrieving_corpus',
        detail: 'retrieving references and claiming the hosted run',
    });
    const pageWords = dependencies.pageWords?.trim();
    const record = await prepareDraftRun({
        paths,
        client: corpusClient,
        hostedClient,
        origin: config.origin,
        query,
        corpusQuery,
        mode,
        aspect,
        imageProfile,
        candidateCount,
        ...(corpusMode ? { corpusMode } : {}),
        retain,
        ...(pageWords ? { pageWords } : {}),
        ...(pageRoute ? { pageRoute } : {}),
        ...(dependencies.redrawGeneration && dependencies.redrawGeneration > 0
            ? { redrawGeneration: dependencies.redrawGeneration }
            : {}),
        ...(redesignSource ? { redesignSource } : {}),
    });
    return preparedFromRecord({ record, adopted, runKey });
};
const draftHostedClient = (flags, dependencies) => {
    if (dependencies.hostedClient)
        return dependencies.hostedClient;
    const config = (dependencies.readConfig ?? readConversionConfig)({
        origin: stringFlag(flags, 'origin'),
        apiKey: stringFlag(flags, 'api-key'),
    });
    return (dependencies.createHostedClient
        ?? ((value) => new TwelveUiBranchClient(value)))(config);
};
const dispatchPreparedDraft = async (args) => {
    const client = draftHostedClient(args.flags, args.dependencies);
    const progress = args.dependencies.progress;
    const attemptFile = draftPaths(args.prepared.runDir).dispatchAttempt;
    const attempt = await startDraftDispatchAttempt({
        file: attemptFile,
        runId: args.prepared.runId,
    });
    try {
        // Identity said once; ticks carry counts, not the run id.
        progress?.note(`claimed hosted run ${args.prepared.runId}`);
        progress?.update({
            stage: 'dispatching',
            completed: 0,
            total: args.prepared.candidateCount,
            unit: 'slots settled',
        });
        const dispatched = await dispatchHostedDraftSlots({
            client,
            runId: args.prepared.runId,
            onReceiptFreeRecovery: (message) => { progress?.note(message); },
        });
        const pending = dispatched.run.candidates.filter((candidate) => candidate.status === 'pending');
        if (dispatched.failures.length > 0) {
            const detail = dispatched.failures.map((failure) => (`${failure.slot}: ${failure.error}`)).join('; ');
            throw new HostedDraftFailureError(args.context === 'draft'
                ? `Hosted draft foreground dispatch could not be confirmed: ${detail}.`
                    + ` Check it with \`12ui next ${args.prepared.runDir}\` before retrying.`
                : `Hosted draft repair could not be confirmed: ${detail}.`
                    + ' This wait stopped; the recorded run is unchanged.'
                    + ' Check the hosted state before retrying it.', 'hosted_draft_dispatch_unconfirmed');
        }
        if (pending.length > 0) {
            const failureBySlot = new Map(dispatched.failures.map((failure) => [failure.slot, failure.error]));
            const detail = pending.map((candidate) => (`${candidate.slot}: ${failureBySlot.get(candidate.slot) ?? 'dispatch did not start'}`)).join('; ');
            throw new HostedDraftFailureError(args.context === 'draft'
                ? `Hosted draft dispatch did not start every slot: ${detail}.`
                    + ` Recover with \`12ui next ${args.prepared.runDir} --wait\`.`
                : `Hosted draft repair did not start every pending slot: ${detail}.`
                    + ' This wait stopped; the recorded run is unchanged.'
                    + ' Restore network access before retrying it.', 'hosted_draft_dispatch_incomplete');
        }
        const counts = summarizeHostedDraftRun(dispatched.run);
        progress?.update({
            stage: 'dispatched',
            completed: counts.succeeded + counts.failed,
            total: dispatched.run.candidates.length,
            unit: 'slots settled',
            running: counts.dispatched,
            detail: `${dispatched.dispatched.length} foreground dispatch request(s) completed`,
        });
        return { client, dispatched };
    }
    finally {
        await finishDraftDispatchAttempt({ file: attemptFile, attempt }).catch(() => undefined);
    }
};
const materializePreparedDraft = async (args) => {
    const progress = args.progress;
    const run = await waitForHostedDraftRun({
        client: args.client,
        run: args.run,
        ...(args.sleep ? { sleep: args.sleep } : {}),
        onProgress: (current) => {
            const counts = summarizeHostedDraftRun(current);
            progress?.update({
                stage: 'generating',
                completed: counts.succeeded + counts.failed,
                total: current.candidates.length,
                unit: 'slots settled',
                running: counts.dispatched,
                detail: `${counts.pending} waiting, ${counts.failed} failed`,
            });
        },
    });
    if (!hostedDraftRunIsSettled(run)) {
        throw new HostedDraftFailureError(`Hosted draft ${run.id} did not settle within 30 minutes; 12ui next ${args.prepared.runDir}`, 'hosted_draft_unsettled');
    }
    const failed = run.candidates.filter((candidate) => candidate.status === 'failed');
    if (failed.length > 0) {
        const detail = failed.map((candidate) => (`${candidate.slot}: ${candidate.error?.message ?? 'generation failed'}`)).join('; ');
        throw new HostedDraftFailureError(`Hosted draft ${run.id} settled with failed slot(s): ${detail}`, 'hosted_draft_generation_failed');
    }
    const files = await downloadHostedDraftCandidates({
        client: args.client,
        run,
        candidates: args.prepared.record.hosted.candidates,
    });
    progress?.update({
        stage: 'materialize',
        completed: files.length,
        total: args.prepared.candidateCount,
        unit: 'candidates downloaded',
        detail: 'writing hosted candidates locally',
    });
    if (files.length !== args.prepared.candidateCount) {
        throw new HostedDraftFailureError(`Hosted draft ${run.id} settled ${args.prepared.candidateCount} slot(s) but downloaded ${files.length}`, 'hosted_draft_download_incomplete');
    }
    const paths = draftPaths(args.prepared.runDir);
    await writeDraftCompletion(paths.completion, {
        version: 1,
        runId: run.id,
        completedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        candidates: files,
    });
    if (args.emitResult !== false) {
        const newlyDispatchedCount = args.newlyDispatchedCount ?? 0;
        progress?.finish('succeeded', {
            artifacts: [{
                    name: `${files.length} candidate image(s)`,
                    state: 'succeeded',
                    path: paths.candidatesDir,
                }],
            spend: newlyDispatchedCount > 0
                ? `${newlyDispatchedCount} recorded pending draft slot(s) dispatched;`
                    + ' settled slots were not re-bought'
                : 'nothing new — the recorded run was collected',
            next: `choose an image, then 12ui branch execute --start <image> or 12ui convert <image>. ${CHOOSING_STARTS_FROM_BRIEF}`,
        });
        console.log(JSON.stringify({
            runDir: args.prepared.runDir,
            runId: run.id,
            candidates: files,
            nextAction: `Pass the chosen image in ${paths.candidatesDir} to 12ui branch execute --start or 12ui convert. ${CHOOSING_STARTS_FROM_BRIEF}`,
        }, null, 2));
    }
    return [paths.draftRecord, paths.completion, ...files.map((file) => file.path)];
};
/**
 * The resumable handle for a run already on disk. Its `runKey` has to come out
 * equal to the one that run claimed, so it is rebuilt from recorded fields
 * only — including `corpus.explicitMode`, which exists for exactly this.
 */
export const preparedDraftFromDirectory = async (runDir) => {
    const paths = draftPaths(runDir);
    const record = await readDraftRecord(paths.draftRecord);
    if (!record || record.version !== 2)
        throw new Error(`No resumable hosted draft in ${paths.runDir}`);
    const runKey = draftLocalRunKey({
        query: record.query,
        corpusQuery: record.corpus.query,
        candidateCount: record.hosted.candidates.length,
        redesignSourceSha256: record.redesignSource?.sha256 ?? null,
        aspect: record.aspect,
        mode: record.mode,
        retainIdentity: draftRetainIdentity(record.retain ?? null),
        // The recorded explicit mode, never the resolved one: an image-conditioned
        // run resolves to balanced without anyone naming it, and treating that as
        // an override would rebuild a key the run never claimed.
        ...(record.corpus.explicitMode ? { corpusMode: record.corpus.explicitMode } : {}),
        ...(record.corpus.retrievalAdjustment ? { corpusAdjustedMode: record.corpus.retrievalAdjustment.effectiveMode } : {}),
        ...(record.imageProfile ? { imageProfile: record.imageProfile } : {}),
        ...(record.imageProfile ? {} : record.imageModel ? { imageModel: record.imageModel } : {}),
        ...(record.pageRoute ? { pageRoute: record.pageRoute } : {}),
        ...(record.redrawGeneration && record.redrawGeneration > 0
            ? { redrawGeneration: record.redrawGeneration }
            : {}),
    });
    return preparedFromRecord({ record, adopted: true, runKey });
};
/** Foreground repair for the exact recorded run. Settled slots are never posted. */
export const repairDraftDispatch = async (runDir, flags = {}, dependencies = {}) => {
    const prepared = await preparedDraftFromDirectory(runDir);
    return (await dispatchPreparedDraft({
        prepared,
        flags,
        dependencies,
        context: 'repair',
    })).dispatched.run;
};
/** Materialize a settled successful run once; polling remains the caller's job. */
export const materializeDraftIfSettled = async (runDir, flags = {}, dependencies = {}) => {
    const prepared = await preparedDraftFromDirectory(runDir);
    const paths = draftPaths(prepared.runDir);
    const alreadyComplete = await stat(paths.completion).then(() => true).catch(() => false);
    if (alreadyComplete)
        return true;
    const client = draftHostedClient(flags, dependencies);
    const run = await client.getRun(prepared.runId);
    if (!hostedDraftRunIsSettled(run))
        return false;
    if (run.candidates.some((candidate) => candidate.status === 'failed'))
        return false;
    await materializePreparedDraft({
        prepared,
        client,
        run,
        emitResult: false,
    });
    return true;
};
export const runDraftCommand = async (flags, dependencies = {}) => {
    if (booleanFlag(flags, 'dry-run')) {
        throw new CliRefusal('`12ui draft --dry-run` is not supported. Nothing was claimed, dispatched, or bought.', 'draft_dry_run_unsupported');
    }
    const progress = createLongRunningProgress({
        label: 'draft',
        typicalSeconds: HOSTED_DRAFT_CANDIDATE_DURATION_SECONDS,
        quiet: booleanFlag(flags, 'quiet'),
    });
    try {
        const candidateCount = readCandidateCount(flags);
        // Before the paid brief, not after it: a Draft that cannot run must not
        // first be quoted a price. The same assertion runs again inside
        // prepareDraftCommand, which improve and redesign enter directly.
        assertReferenceSearchServable({
            mode: parseDraftCorpusMode(stringFlag(flags, 'corpus-mode')),
            referenceImage: Boolean(stringFlag(flags, 'reference')?.trim() ?? stringFlag(flags, 'redesign-source')?.trim()),
            flag: DRAFT_CORPUS_MODE_FLAG,
        });
        const corpusQuery = await readDraftCorpusQuery(flags, readDraftConcept(flags), dependencies.plannedDraft?.corpusQuery);
        const retrieval = draftReferenceRetrieval({
            override: parseDraftCorpusMode(stringFlag(flags, 'corpus-mode')),
            candidateCount,
            query: corpusQuery,
            referenceImage: Boolean(stringFlag(flags, 'reference')?.trim() ?? stringFlag(flags, 'redesign-source')?.trim()),
        });
        if (retrieval.adjustment) {
            (dependencies.warn ?? ((line) => { process.stderr.write(`${line}\n`); }))(retrieval.adjustment.reason);
        }
        progress.brief({
            request: `draft: ${candidateCount} hosted candidate(s) from the concept`,
            paid: `up to ${candidateCount} never-started draft slot(s);`
                + ' the recorded hosted run replays without a second purchase',
            done: booleanFlag(flags, 'wait')
                ? 'one PNG per candidate in <run-dir>/candidates'
                : 'every candidate slot durably dispatched; `12ui next <run-dir> --wait` collects PNGs',
            expectation: {
                typicalSeconds: HOSTED_DRAFT_CANDIDATE_DURATION_SECONDS,
                basis: 'measured median per candidate; slots run concurrently',
            },
            blocking: true,
        });
        progress.update({ stage: 'prepare', detail: 'preparing the hosted draft' });
        const prepared = await prepareDraftCommand(flags, { ...dependencies, progress, corpusAdjustmentReported: Boolean(retrieval.adjustment) });
        const { client, dispatched } = await dispatchPreparedDraft({
            prepared,
            flags,
            dependencies: { ...dependencies, progress },
            context: 'draft',
        });
        if (!booleanFlag(flags, 'wait')) {
            const paths = draftPaths(prepared.runDir);
            const collect = `12ui next ${prepared.runDir} --wait`;
            // The draft's own answer carries the redirect, so it reaches an agent whose project notes name this route.
            const nextAction = `Collect the candidates: ${collect}. ${CHOOSING_STARTS_FROM_BRIEF}`;
            progress.finish('succeeded', {
                detail: 'every never-started slot completed its foreground dispatch request',
                artifacts: [{
                        name: 'hosted run',
                        state: `generation stays server-side (run ${prepared.runId})`,
                    }],
                spend: dispatched.dispatched.length > 0
                    ? `${dispatched.dispatched.length} recorded pending draft slot(s) dispatched`
                    : 'nothing new — the recorded run was already in flight or settled',
                next: nextAction,
            });
            console.log(JSON.stringify({
                runDir: prepared.runDir,
                runId: prepared.runId,
                dispatched: dispatched.dispatched,
                nextAction,
            }, null, 2));
            return {
                prepared,
                complete: false,
                artifacts: [prepared.recordPath, paths.dispatchAttempt],
            };
        }
        const artifacts = await materializePreparedDraft({
            prepared,
            client,
            run: dispatched.run,
            progress,
            newlyDispatchedCount: dispatched.dispatched.length,
            ...(dependencies.emitResult === false ? { emitResult: false } : {}),
            ...(dependencies.sleep ? { sleep: dependencies.sleep } : {}),
        });
        if (dependencies.emitResult === false)
            progress.finish('succeeded', { detail: `${prepared.candidateCount} candidate image(s) in ${draftPaths(prepared.runDir).candidatesDir}` });
        return { prepared, complete: true, artifacts };
    }
    catch (error) {
        progress.finish('stopped', {
            detail: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),
        });
        throw error;
    }
};
const readDraftAttemptRecord = async (referencesDir) => {
    try {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(await readFile(path.join(referencesDir, INSPIRATION_ATTEMPT_FILE), 'utf8'));
        return { createdAt: typeof parsed.createdAt === 'string' ? parsed.createdAt : 'an earlier time' };
    }
    catch {
        return null;
    }
};
export const readDraftStatus = async (runDirArgument, flags = {}, dependencies = {}) => {
    const paths = draftPaths(runDirArgument);
    const record = await readDraftRecord(paths.draftRecord);
    if (!record || record.version !== 2) {
        const started = await readDraftAttemptRecord(paths.referencesDir);
        throw new CliRefusal(started
            ? `The draft run in ${paths.runDir} failed before its hosted run was recorded — it started`
                + ` at ${started.createdAt}. Re-run the same draft command; its corpus key replays rather`
                + ' than starting a new retrieval.'
            : `No hosted draft run is recorded in ${paths.runDir}. Start one with`
                + ' `12ui draft --concept "<product, audience, surface, goal, personality>"`.', started ? 'draft_incomplete' : 'draft_absent');
    }
    const client = dependencies.hostedClient ?? new TwelveUiBranchClient((dependencies.readConfig ?? readConversionConfig)({
        origin: stringFlag(flags, 'origin'),
        apiKey: stringFlag(flags, 'api-key'),
    }));
    const run = await client.getRun(record.hosted.runId);
    if (run.id !== record.hosted.runId)
        throw new Error('The hosted draft service returned the wrong run');
    const bySlot = new Map(run.candidates.map((candidate) => [candidate.slot, candidate]));
    const candidates = record.hosted.candidates.map((candidate) => ({
        id: candidate.id,
        slot: candidate.slot,
        status: bySlot.get(candidate.slot)?.status ?? 'missing',
        path: candidate.outputPath,
    }));
    const counts = summarizeHostedDraftRun(run);
    const settled = hostedDraftRunIsSettled(run);
    const localCount = (await Promise.all(record.hosted.candidates.map((candidate) => (stat(candidate.outputPath).then(() => true).catch(() => false))))).filter(Boolean).length;
    const failed = counts.failed > 0;
    const stalled = !settled && counts.pending > 0 && counts.dispatched === 0;
    const observedAt = (dependencies.now ?? Date.now)();
    const completionRecorded = await stat(paths.completion).then(() => true).catch(() => false);
    const materialized = localCount === record.hosted.candidates.length && completionRecorded;
    const elapsedSeconds = secondsSince(run.createdAt, observedAt);
    return {
        runDir: paths.runDir,
        runId: run.id,
        query: record.query,
        phase: failed
            ? 'failed'
            : stalled
                ? 'stalled'
                : settled
                    ? materialized ? 'ready' : 'materializing'
                    : 'generating',
        complete: settled && (failed || materialized),
        recoverable: stalled,
        ...(elapsedSeconds === undefined ? {} : { elapsedSeconds: Math.round(elapsedSeconds) }),
        candidates,
        narrative: failed
            ? `${counts.failed} of ${run.candidates.length} hosted draft slot(s) failed; settled slots are not re-bought.`
            : stalled
                ? `The hosted draft run has ${counts.pending} pending slot${counts.pending === 1 ? '' : 's'} and nothing running server-side.`
                    + ` Recover with \`12ui next ${paths.runDir} --wait\`.`
                : settled && materialized
                    ? `${counts.succeeded} hosted candidates settled; ${localCount} image(s) are in ${paths.candidatesDir}.`
                    : settled
                        ? `${counts.succeeded} hosted candidates settled; ${localCount} of`
                            + ` ${record.hosted.candidates.length} image(s) are materialized locally.`
                        : `${counts.succeeded + counts.failed} of ${run.candidates.length} hosted candidates settled.`,
    };
};
export const readHostedRunStatus = async (args) => await args.client.getRun(args.runId);

const callerDeadlineMs = (flags) => {
    const raw = stringFlag(flags, 'timeout-ms');
    if (raw === undefined)
        return undefined;
    if (!booleanFlag(flags, 'wait')) {
        throw new CliRefusal('--timeout-ms is a caller deadline for `12ui next --wait`; add --wait or remove the deadline.', 'next_timeout_without_wait');
    }
    const parsed = Number(raw);
    if (!Number.isFinite(parsed) || parsed < 1_000) {
        throw new CliRefusal('--timeout-ms must be a number of at least 1000', 'next_timeout_invalid');
    }
    return Math.floor(parsed);
};

        // A status read works offline; it just cannot refresh from the service.

/**
 * A draft whose `12ui draft` has claimed the directory and not yet recorded its
 * hosted run.
 *
 * MEASURED (0.2.104 gate): agents start `12ui draft` and, before it writes
 * `draft.json`, run `12ui next <dir> --wait`. That directory read as a
 * workspace, so the wait exited at once and the next command was refused for
 * want of a finished draft. It is a draft in progress: it answers as one, and
 * waits as one, until `draft.json` lands and the ordinary draft reading takes
 * over. A claim whose owner is gone cannot finish, so that is the same refusal
 * a draft that died before recording its run has always given.
 */
const readClaimingDraft = async (directory, observedAt, owner) => {
    if (owner.owner === 'gone') {
        throw new CliRefusal(`The draft run in ${directory} failed before its hosted run was recorded: the`
            + `${owner.pid === undefined ? '' : ` \`12ui draft\` (process ${owner.pid})`}`
            + ' that claimed this directory is no longer running. Re-run the same draft command;'
            + ' it continues this directory and its corpus key replays rather than starting'
            + ' a new retrieval.', 'draft_incomplete');
    }
    const elapsedSeconds = secondsSince(owner.claimedAt, observedAt);
    return {
        kind: 'draft',
        target: directory,
        state: 'claiming',
        complete: false,
        typicalSeconds: HOSTED_DRAFT_CANDIDATE_DURATION_SECONDS,
        ...(elapsedSeconds === undefined ? {} : { elapsedSeconds }),
        what: 'A draft',
        narrative: `The draft in ${directory} is still being created: \`12ui draft\` has claimed`
            + ' this directory and has not recorded 
  .map((entry) => ({ id: entry.pageId, stage: entry.stage })),

            detail: `${report.counts.waiting} waiting, ${report.counts.blocked} blocked,`
                + ` ${report.counts.failed} failed`,
        },
    };

/**
 * A conversion the caller is holding the id of.
 *
 * WHY THIS ANSWERS RATHER THAN REFUSES. It used to refuse — a conversion is
 * collected, not watched — and the refusal was right about the mechanics and
 * useless at the moment it fired. Measured 2026-08-14: an agent holding a
 * conversion id while its blocking convert ran typed exactly this, five times
 * across five runs, and got told the id "names no run this command can read".
 * The id was the only handle it had, reading a conversion is a free GET, and
 * `resume` — the command that does collect it — blocks for minutes. So the free
 * read answers, and it names `resume` as what comes next.
 */
const readConversion = async (conversionId, flags, observedAt = Date.now()) => {
    const client = new TwelveUiConversionClient(readConversionConfig({
        origin: stringFlag(flags, 'origin'),
        apiKey: stringFlag(flags, 'api-key'),
    }));

            },

        });

            ...(report.elapsedSeconds === undefined ? {} : { elapsedSeconds: report.elapsedSeconds }),

            if (claiming()) {

                progress,
            });
            report = await read();
            // A service GET may durably recover an old receipt-free dispatch from
            // `dispatched` to `pending`. Repair the state just observed, rather than
            // deciding once from an earlier snapshot and then stopping on the newer one.

                    ...(dependencies.draftClient ? { hostedClient: dependencies.draftClient } : {}),
                    progress,
                });
                report = await read();
            }
        };

                await advanceDraft(target.directory);

                    progress.update({

const processIsAlive = (pid) => {
    try {
        process.kill(pid, 0);
        return true;
    }
    catch (error) {
        // EPERM means the process exists and belongs to somebody else.
        return error.code === 'EPERM';
    }
};
/**
 * A claim is stale only when its owner is provably gone. A claim written on
 * another host cannot be checked from here, so it counts as live: refusing to
 * adopt costs one stranded sibling, while adopting a directory somebody else is
 * still writing costs a torn run.
 */
const claimIsLive = (claim) => (claim.hostname !== os.hostname() || processIsAlive(claim.pid));
/**
 * A directory without `draft.json` has not claimed a hosted run yet and can be
 * reset before replaying its corpus key. A directory with the record is the
 * resumable local handle for that exact service run and must be kept intact.
 */
const runDirectoryIsIncomplete = async (paths) => {
    return !await pathExists(paths.draftRecord);
};
/** A claim file is created empty and then written; this is how long that may look unreadable. */
const UNREADABLE_CLAIM_GRACE_MS = 60_000;
/**
 * Whether the draft that claimed `runDir` can still be working in it. This is
 * the one liveness rule adoption already uses, exposed so `12ui next` does not
 * wait on a draft whose process died before it recorded its hosted run.
 */
export const observeDraftClaim = async (runDir, now = Date.now) => {
    const existing = await readDraftRunClaim(runDir);
    if (existing.state === 'present') {
        return {
            owner: claimIsLive(existing.claim) ? 'live' : 'gone',
            ...(existing.claim.claimedAt ? { claimedAt: existing.claim.claimedAt } : {}),
            pid: existing.claim.pid,
        };
    }
    if (existing.state === 'absent')
        return { owner: 'gone' };
    const written = await stat(claimPathFor(runDir)).then((entry) => entry.mtimeMs).catch(() => 0);
    return { owner: now() - written < UNREADABLE_CLAIM_GRACE_MS ? 'live' : 'gone' };
};
const writeClaimExclusively = async (runDir, claim) => {
    try {
        await writeFile(claimPathFor(runDir), `${JSON.stringify(claim, null, 2)}\n`,

import { readFile } from 'node:fs/promises';

/** Keep image instructions intact; retrieval has its own, shorter caption. */
export const readDraftCorpusQuery = async (flags, concept, plannedQuery) => {
    const explicit = stringFlag(flags, 'corpus-query');
    if (explicit !== undefined && plannedQuery !== undefined) {
        throw new Error('--corpus-query cannot override the query in a durable redesign plan.');
    }
    const raw = explicit?.startsWith('@')
        ? await readFile(explicit.slice(1), 'utf8')
        : explicit ?? plannedQuery ?? concept;
    const normalized = raw.replace(/\s+/gu, ' ').trim();
    if (!normalized)
        throw new Error('--corpus-query must not be empty');
    const mode = referenceSearchMode({
        override: parseDraftCorpusMode(stringFlag(flags, 'corpus-mode')),
        referenceImage: Boolean(stringFlag(flags, 'reference')?.trim()
            ?? stringFlag(flags, 'redesign-source')?.trim()),
        flag: '--corpus-mode',
    });
    return mode === 'hedge' || explicit !== undefined ? normalized : raw;
};

FILE versions/0.2.130/node_modules/@12ui/design/dist/draft-run.js
import { mkdir, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
import path from 'node:path';
import { downloadCorpusInspiration } from './cli-corpus-run.js';
import { INSPIRATION_MANIFEST_FILE, } from './cli-corpus-types.js';
import { DEFAULT_INSPIRATION_MODE, INSPIRATION_MODES, } from './corpus-client.js';
import { draftCorpusKey } from './draft-identity.js';
import { hedgeReferenceImageRefusal, resolveReferenceSearch, } from './reference-search-mode.js';
import { draftRetainIdentity, draftRetainsLayout } from './draft-retain.js';
import { hostedDraftRunKey, } from './hosted-draft-identity.js';
import { DRAFT_CANDIDATE_IDS, draftReferenceFile, writeDraftRecord, } from './draft-workspace.js';
/** Hosted draft preparation: one corpus search, one service run claim, no local provider. */
export const DRAFT_CANDIDATE_COUNT = 4;
export const DRAFT_CANDIDATE_COUNT_MINIMUM = 2;
export const DRAFT_CANDIDATE_COUNT_MAXIMUM = DRAFT_CANDIDATE_IDS.length;
/**
 * The slate every mode but hedge asks for: the historical Draft width, widened
 * to the slot count when a Draft asks for more slots than that, because a
 * Draft that cannot pair one reference per slot refuses outright.
 */
export const DRAFT_WIDE_REFERENCE_COUNT = 12;
/** What a caller writes to choose a mode other than the default, at both surfaces. */
export const DRAFT_CORPUS_MODE_FLAG = '--corpus-mode';
export const DRAFT_CORPUS_MODE_FLAG_REFUSAL = `${DRAFT_CORPUS_MODE_FLAG} must be one of ${INSPIRATION_MODES.join(', ')}; without it a Draft searches ${DEFAULT_INSPIRATION_MODE}.`;
/** `--corpus-mode` as the caller wrote it; absent means the default, not balanced. */
export const parseDraftCorpusMode = (value) => {
    const trimmed = value?.trim();
    if (!trimmed)
        return undefined;
    if (!INSPIRATION_MODES.includes(trimmed)) {
        throw new Error(DRAFT_CORPUS_MODE_FLAG_REFUSAL);
    }
    return trimmed;
};
/** An explicit hedge against an image query would 400 after the run was claimed. */
export const DRAFT_HEDGE_REFERENCE_IMAGE_REFUSAL = hedgeReferenceImageRefusal(DRAFT_CORPUS_MODE_FLAG);
/**
 * The retrieval a Draft runs, and the only place that decides it.
 *
 * Hedge is the default and needs no flag (COO with owner authority,
 * 2026-09-07): it spreads the first references across distinct directions
 * while holding the query, which is exactly what pairing one reference per
 * Draft slot is for. The default is `DEFAULT_INSPIRATION_MODE`, the same
 * constant `12ui corpus inspire` and the MCP surface read, so the command line
 * has one reference-search default rather than two that can drift.
 *
 * The caller selects it with `--corpus-mode`; overlong hedge queries use
 * balanced with their full text and a recorded reason. The
 * Worker's advertised `draftReferenceMode` deliberately does not override it,
 * and is no longer read here: the Worker resolves anything that is not the
 * exact string `hedge` to `balanced` (`workers/api/src/corpus/route.ts`), so an
 * advertised `balanced` cannot be told apart from an unset variable and carries
 * no operator intent for a client default to yield to. Nothing is bypassed by
 * ignoring it — the inspire route accepts any mode per request from an
 * account-tier caller (`workers/api/src/corpus/validation.ts`), so the old gate
 * was the CLI policing itself.
 *
 * The one thing that outranks the default is not a preference but a fact the
 * caller already handed in: whether this search carries their own image. A
 * redesign Draft (`--reference`, `--redesign-source`) and every `12ui improve`
 * draft stage condition retrieval on the captured page, and the corpus refuses
 * hedge for those outright, so they run `REFERENCE_IMAGE_SEARCH_MODE` — the
 * second hardcoded mode in the CLI, and deliberately so; see
 * `reference-search-mode.ts`, which owns both the mode and the refusal. This
 * function only adds the slate width; it does not decide the mode.
 */
export const draftReferenceRetrieval = (args) => {
    // The only meaningful bound is the Draft slot window the CLI already
    // advertises (--candidates 2-16). It is deliberately expressed with those
    // constants and not with a retrieval cap: an earlier 4..12 here mirrored the
    // corpus serving cap of the day and hard-refused the 2- and 3-slot Drafts the
    // CLI accepts everywhere else.
    if (!Number.isInteger(args.candidateCount)
        || args.candidateCount < DRAFT_CANDIDATE_COUNT_MINIMUM
        || args.candidateCount > DRAFT_CANDIDATE_COUNT_MAXIMUM) {
        throw new Error(`A Draft needs between ${DRAFT_CANDIDATE_COUNT_MINIMUM} and ${DRAFT_CANDIDATE_COUNT_MAXIMUM}`
            + ` slots; received ${args.candidateCount}.`);
    }
    const resolution = resolveReferenceSearch({
        ...(args.override ? { override: args.override } : {}),
        referenceImage: args.referenceImage,
        flag: DRAFT_CORPUS_MODE_FLAG,
        query: args.query ?? '',
    });
    const { mode, adjustment } = resolution;
    return mode === 'hedge'
        ? { mode, k: args.candidateCount }
        : { mode, k: Math.max(DRAFT_WIDE_REFERENCE_COUNT, args.candidateCount), ...(adjustment ? { adjustment } : {}) };
};
/**
 * Paid retrieval identity. The resolved retrieval is required, not defaulted:
 * a Draft's mode is decided by `draftReferenceRetrieval`, and a default here
 * would let a caller that forgot to pass it mint a second identity for the
 * same search. Mode and k are both hashed, so a Draft of the same concept run
 * under a different mode is a different paid search, not a replay of the old
 * one — which is what a different reference set deserves.
 */
export const draftRunCorpusKey = (args) => draftCorpusKey({
    query: args.query,
    mode: args.retrieval.mode,
    count: args.retrieval.k,
    redesignSourceSha256: args.redesignSourceSha256 ?? null,
});
const draftSlotFor = (index) => String.fromCharCode('a'.charCodeAt(0) + index);
const assertClaimedSlots = (expected, actual) => {
    const expectedSlots = expected.map((candidate) => candidate.slot);
    const actualSlots = actual.candidates.map((candidate) => candidate.slot);
    if (JSON.stringify(expectedSlots) !== JSON.stringify(actualSlots)) {
        throw new Error(`Hosted draft ${actual.id} returned slots ${actualSlots.join(', ') || '(none)'};`
            + ` expected ${expectedSlots.join(', ')}`);
    }
};
export const prepareDraftRun = async (input) => {
    const now = input.now ?? (() => new Date());
    const corpusQuery = input.corpusQuery ?? input.query;
    const retrieval = draftReferenceRetrieval({
        ...(input.corpusMode ? { override: input.corpusMode } : {}),
        candidateCount: input.candidateCount,
        query: corpusQuery,
        referenceImage: Boolean(input.redesignSource),
    });
    const manifest = await downloadCorpusInspiration({
        client: input.client,
        ...(retrieval.adjustment ? { retrievalAdjustment: retrieval.adjustment } : {}),
        request: { q: corpusQuery, mode: retrieval.mode, k: retrieval.k },
        outDir: input.paths.referencesDir,
        origin: input.origin,
        idempotencyKey: draftRunCorpusKey({
            query: corpusQuery,
            retrieval,
            redesignSourceSha256: input.redesignSource?.sha256 ?? null,
        }),
        derivedIdempotencyKey: true,
        ...(input.redesignSource
            ? { referenceImage: { evidence: input.redesignSource.evidence, input: input.redesignSource.input } }
            : {}),
        now,
    });
    const references = [...manifest.references].sort((left, right) => left.ordinal - right.ordinal);
    if (references.length < input.candidateCount) {
        throw new Error(`The corpus returned ${references.length} reference(s) for this query and a draft needs`
            + ` ${input.candidateCount}. Broaden the concept and run 12ui draft again; no hosted image`
            + ' slot has been dispatched.');
    }
    const usesUpload = Boolean(input.redesignSource);
    const retainsLayout = draftRetainsLayout(input.retain);
    const requestCandidates = DRAFT_CANDIDATE_IDS
        .slice(0, input.candidateCount)
        .map((_id, index) => usesUpload
        ? { slot: draftSlotFor(index), useReferenceImage: true }
        : {
            slot: draftSlotFor(index),
            referenceId: references[index].id,
            ...(references[index].evidence ? { referenceEvidence: references[index].evidence } : {}),
        });
    let referenceImage;
    if (input.redesignSource) {
        referenceImage = {
            data: Buffer.from(input.redesignSource.input.bytes).toString('base64'),
            mediaType: input.redesignSource.input.mediaType,
            sha256: input.redesignSource.evidence.sha256,
        };
    }
    const hostedMode = retainsLayout ? 'preserve-structure' : 'inspiration';
    const idempotencyKey = hostedDraftRunKey({
        concept: input.query,
        aspect: input.aspect,
        mode: hostedMode,
        candidates: requestCandidates,
        ...(referenceImage ? { referenceImageSha256: referenceImage.sha256 } : {}),
        retainIdentity: draftRetainIdentity(input.retain),
        ...(input.pageWords ? { pageWords: input.pageWords } : {}),
        ...(input.pageRoute ? { pageRoute: input.pageRoute } : {}),
        ...(input.redrawGeneration && input.redrawGeneration > 0
            ? { redrawGeneration: input.redrawGeneration }
            : {}),
        imageProfile: input.imageProfile,
    });
    const hosted = await input.hostedClient.startCreateRun({
        concept: input.query,
        aspect: input.aspect,
        mode: hostedMode,
        imageProfile: input.imageProfile,
        ...(input.retain ? { retain: input.retain } : {}),
        candidates: requestCandidates,
        ...(referenceImage ? { referenceImage } : {}),
        ...(input.pageWords ? { words: input.pageWords } : {}),
    }, idempotencyKey);
    assertClaimedSlots(requestCandidates, hosted);
    await mkdir(input.paths.candidatesDir, { recursive: true });
    // The caller's own image is kept in the run by its digest, so later work on this run (the local workspace's brand
    // reference, slate-brand.ts) draws with the very bytes this draft did, wherever the original path goes.
    const referenceFile = input.redesignSource
        ? draftReferenceFile(input.redesignSource.sha256, input.redesignSource.input.mediaType)
        : null;
    if (input.redesignSource && referenceFile) {
        await mkdir(path.join(input.paths.runDir, path.dirname(referenceFile)), { recursive: true, mode: 0o700 });
        await writeFile(path.join(input.paths.runDir, referenceFile), input.redesignSource.input.bytes, { mode: 0o600 });
    }
    const candidates = DRAFT_CANDIDATE_IDS
        .slice(0, input.candidateCount)
        .map((id, index) => {
        const reference = references[index];
        const serviceCandidate = hosted.candidates[index];
        return {
            id,
            slot: serviceCandidate.slot,
            direction: serviceCandidate.direction,
            outputPath: path.join(input.paths.candidatesDir, `${id}.png`),
            referenceId: usesUpload ? null : reference.id,
            referencePath: usesUpload ? input.redesignSource.path : reference.file,
            referenceSha256: usesUpload ? input.redesignSource.sha256 : reference.sha256,
        };
    });
    const record = {
        version: 2,
        createdAt: now().toISOString(),
        ...(input.redrawGeneration && input.redrawGeneration > 0
            ? { redrawGeneration: input.redrawGeneration }
            : {}),
        runDir: input.paths.runDir,
        query: input.query,
        mode: input.mode,
        aspect: input.aspect,
        referenceMode: hostedMode,
        imageProfile: input.imageProfile,
        retain: input.retain,
        origin: input.origin,
        redesignSource: input.redesignSource
            ? { path: input.redesignSource.path, sha256: input.redesignSource.sha256, ...(referenceFile ? { file: referenceFile } : {}) }
            : null,
        ...(input.pageRoute ? { pageRoute: input.pageRoute } : {}),
        corpus: {
            query: corpusQuery,
            mode: manifest.response.mode,
            ...(retrieval.adjustment ? { retrievalAdjustment: retrieval.adjustment } : {}),
            ...(input.corpusMode ? { explicitMode: input.corpusMode } : {}),
            setId: manifest.response.setId,
            idempotencyKey: manifest.idempotencyKey,
            manifestPath: path.join(input.paths.referencesDir, INSPIRATION_MANIFEST_FILE),
            references: references.map((reference) => ({
                ordinal: reference.ordinal,
                id: reference.id,
                path: reference.file,
                sha256: reference.sha256,
                aspect: reference.aspect,
                ...(reference.evidence ? { evidence: reference.evidence } : {}),
            })),
        },
        hosted: {
            runId: hosted.id,
            idempotencyKey,
            candidates,
        },
    };
    await writeDraftRecord(input.paths.draftRecord, record);
    return record;
};

FILE versions/0.2.130/node_modules/@12ui/design/dist/draft-workspace.js
import { mkdtemp, readFile, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
import os from 'node:os';
import path from 'node:path';
/**
 * The run directory `12ui draft` creates and every later command is handed.
 *
 * It lives under the system temp root, not the working directory: measured
 * across two harness passes, agents both spammed the user's repo with run
 * artifacts and hardcoded `/tmp/<product>-12ui`, which ignores TMPDIR and
 * collides the moment two runs share a machine. `mkdtemp` settles both — the
 * directory is unique by construction and the caller never has to invent a
 * path. The command prints it as its first line because it is the one value
 * every subsequent command needs.
 */
export const DRAFT_RECORD_FILENAME = 'draft.json';
export const DRAFT_REFERENCES_DIRECTORY = 'references';
export const DRAFT_CANDIDATES_DIRECTORY = 'candidates';
export const DRAFT_DISPATCH_ATTEMPT_FILENAME = 'draft.dispatch.json';
export const DRAFT_COMPLETION_FILENAME = 'draft.complete.json';
export const DRAFT_BRANCH_DIRECTORY = 'branch';
/** The caller's own `--reference` image, kept in the run by its digest (`reference/<sha256>.<ext>`). */
export const DRAFT_REFERENCE_DIRECTORY = 'reference';
export const DRAFT_REFERENCE_FILE_PATTERN = /^reference\/[0-9a-f]{64}\.(?:png|jpg|webp)$/u;
const REFERENCE_EXTENSIONS = { 'image/png': 'png', 'image/jpeg': 'jpg', 'image/webp': 'webp' };
/** Where a run keeps its reference image, relative to the run directory, so a moved run still finds it. */
export const draftReferenceFile = (sha256, mediaType) => (`${DRAFT_REFERENCE_DIRECTORY}/${sha256}.${REFERENCE_EXTENSIONS[mediaType]}`);
export const DRAFT_CANDIDATE_IDS = [
    'A', 'B', 'C', 'D', 'E', 'F', 'G', 'H',
    'I', 'J', 'K', 'L', 'M', 'N', 'O', 'P',
];
/** `Editorial architecture homepage` -> `editorial-architecture-homepage`. */
export const draftSlug = (query) => {
    const slug = query
        .toLowerCase()
        .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/gu, '-')
        .replace(/^-+|-+$/gu, '')
        .split('-')
        .filter(Boolean)
        .slice(0, 4)
        .join('-')
        .slice(0, 32)
        .replace(/-+$/u, '');
    return slug || 'design';
};
export const draftPaths = (runDir) => {
    const resolved = path.resolve(runDir);
    return {
        runDir: resolved,
        referencesDir: path.join(resolved, DRAFT_REFERENCES_DIRECTORY),
        candidatesDir: path.join(resolved, DRAFT_CANDIDATES_DIRECTORY),
        draftRecord: path.join(resolved, DRAFT_RECORD_FILENAME),
        dispatchAttempt: path.join(resolved, DRAFT_DISPATCH_ATTEMPT_FILENAME),
        completion: path.join(resolved, DRAFT_COMPLETION_FILENAME),
        branchDir: path.join(resolved, DRAFT_BRANCH_DIRECTORY),
    };
};
export const createDraftWorkspace = async (args) => {
    const root = args.root ?? os.tmpdir();
    const runDir = await mkdtemp(path.join(root, `12ui-${draftSlug(args.query)}-`));
    return draftPaths(runDir);
};
export const writeDraftRecord = async (file, record) => {
    await writeFile(file, `${JSON.stringify(record, null, 2)}\n`, { encoding: 'utf8', mode: 0o600 });
};
export const writeDraftCompletion = async (file, record) => {
    await writeFile(file, `${JSON.stringify(record, null, 2)}\n`, {
        encoding: 'utf8',
        mode: 0o600,
    });
};
export const readDraftRecord = async (file) => {
    try {
        return JSON.parse(await readFile(file, 'utf8'));
    }
    catch {
        return undefined;
    }
};
//# sourceMappingURL=draft-workspace.js.map

FILE versions/0.2.130/node_modules/@12ui/design/dist/hosted-draft-identity.js

FILE versions/0.2.130/node_modules/@12ui/design/dist/hosted-draft-run.js
import { createHash, randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import { mkdir, readFile, rename, rm, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
import path from 'node:path';
import { OPERATION_DURATION_HINTS } from './cli-progress.js';
/** One hosted draft image, generated by the service rather than this machine. */
export const HOSTED_DRAFT_CANDIDATE_DURATION_SECONDS = (OPERATION_DURATION_HINTS.hostedDraftCandidate);
/**
 * The service repairs a receipt-free `dispatched` candidate only when a run
 * read observes it at least ten minutes old. This intentionally mirrors
 * `workers/api/src/create/candidateDispatchRecovery.ts`; the CLI cannot
 * import Worker code, but must not redrive before that durable contract.
 */
export const HOSTED_DRAFT_RECEIPT_FREE_RECOVERY_HORIZON_MS = 10 * 60_000;
/**
 * The 2026-08-29 incident study measured 43.761 s for a healthy two-slot
 * draft from claim through terminal state. Sixteen healthy totals is
 * 700,176 ms (11m 40s): 100,176 ms beyond the service's ten-minute
 * receipt-free reclamation horizon, so a client timeout cannot outrun the
 * server's safe recovery rule.
 */
export const HOSTED_DRAFT_HEALTHY_TOTAL_MS = 43_761;
export const HOSTED_DRAFT_RECEIPT_FREE_STALL_MULTIPLIER = 16;
export const HOSTED_DRAFT_RECEIPT_FREE_STALL_TIMEOUT_MS = (HOSTED_DRAFT_HEALTHY_TOTAL_MS * HOSTED_DRAFT_RECEIPT_FREE_STALL_MULTIPLIER);
export const summarizeHostedDraftRun = (run) => {
    const counts = { pending: 0, dispatched: 0, succeeded: 0, failed: 0 };
    for (const candidate of run.candidates)
        counts[candidate.status] += 1;
    return counts;
};
export const hostedDraftRunIsSettled = (run) => {
    const counts = summarizeHostedDraftRun(run);
    return counts.succeeded + counts.failed === run.candidates.length;
};
/**
 * A hosted draft outcome the CLI already recognizes by shape — dispatch left
 * ambiguous, a slot never started, the run never settled, settlement carried
 * a failed slot, or a settled candidate did not download. Each is a stable,
 * meaningful stop, not an opaque runtime exception, so it carries its own
 * closed-vocabulary {@link classifyRunJournalError} token instead of falling
 * through to `unclassified`. The message stays human-readable prose;
 * `journalErrorClass` is the separate token the journal persists.
 */
const HOSTED_DRAFT_FAILURE_CLASSES = new Set([
    'hosted_draft_dispatch_unconfirmed',
    'hosted_draft_dispatch_incomplete',
    'hosted_draft_unsettled',
    'hosted_draft_generation_failed',
    'hosted_draft_download_incomplete',
]);
export class HostedDraftFailureError extends Error {
    journalErrorClass;
    constructor(message, journalErrorClass) {
        super(message);
        this.name = 'HostedDraftFailureError';
        if (!HOSTED_DRAFT_FAILURE_CLASSES.has(journalErrorClass)) {
            throw new TypeError(`Invalid hosted draft error class: ${journalErrorClass}`);
        }
        this.journalErrorClass = journalErrorClass;
    }
}
const receiptFreeRecoveryMessage = (slot, elapsedMs) => (`slot ${slot.toUpperCase()}: re-dispatched after ${Math.max(1, Math.round(elapsedMs / 60_000))}m without receipt`);
/** Abort one foreground POST rather than leaving its shell pinned forever. */
const dispatchSlotWithDeadline = async (args) => {
    const controller = new AbortController();
    const timeout = setTimeout(() => { controller.abort(); }, args.timeoutMs);
    try {
        await args.client.dispatchScreen(args.runId, args.slot, { signal: controller.signal });
        return 'completed';
    }
    catch (error) {
        // The request is ambiguous only after OUR deadline. Other errors keep their
        // normal failure path rather than being mistaken for safe receipt recovery.
        if (controller.signal.aborted)
            return 'timed-out';
        throw error;
    }
    finally {
        clearTimeout(timeout);
    }
};
/**
 * A timed-out POST might already own paid work. The recovery run read is the
 * server's receipt-free repair trigger: only its explicit `pending` result can
 * permit one unkeyed replay. A still-`dispatched` result is either genuinely
 * active or has an ambiguous receipt, so it fails closed instead of keeping a
 * foreground shell pinned. `attempt_key` remains server-owned, so the replay
 * never creates a second paid effect.
 */
const dispatchHostedDraftSlot = async (args) => {
    const startedAt = args.now();
    const initial = await dispatchSlotWithDeadline(args);
    if (initial === 'completed')
        return;
    const current = await args.client.getRun(args.runId);
    const candidate = current.candidates.find((entry) => entry.slot === args.slot);
    if (!candidate)
        throw new Error(`Hosted draft service returned no state for slot ${args.slot}`);
    if (candidate.status === 'dispatched') {
        throw new Error(`slot ${args.slot.toUpperCase()} remains dispatched after the receipt-free recovery read;`
            + ' no re-dispatch was attempted');
    }
    if (candidate.status !== 'pending')
        return;
    // Exactly one replay: another timeout remains a truthful foreground failure,
    // never a client-side retry loop that could create ambiguity around paid work.
    const replay = await dispatchSlotWithDeadline(args);
    if (replay === 'timed-out') {
        throw new Error(`slot ${args.slot.toUpperCase()} re-dispatch timed out after`
            + ` ${Math.max(1, Math.round((args.now() - startedAt) / 60_000))}m without receipt`);
    }
    args.onReceiptFreeRecovery?.(receiptFreeRecoveryMessage(args.slot, args.now() - startedAt));
};
/**
 * Dispatch only slots which have never started.
 *
 * `dispatched`, `succeeded`, and `failed` are all durable service states. A
 * resume observes them and never posts those slots again; the service remains
 * the paid-effect and ledger authority. A deadline-expired POST is the narrow
 * exception: it performs the server's receipt-free recovery read; only a
 * published `pending` state replays that exact slot once.
 */
export const dispatchHostedDraftSlots = async (args) => {
    const claimed = await args.client.getRun(args.runId);
    const slots = claimed.candidates
        .filter((candidate) => candidate.status === 'pending')
        .map((candidate) => candidate.slot);
    const timeoutMs = args.timeoutMs ?? HOSTED_DRAFT_RECEIPT_FREE_STALL_TIMEOUT_MS;
    const now = args.now ?? Date.now;
    const settled = await Promise.allSettled(slots.map(async (slot) => await dispatchHostedDraftSlot({
        client: args.client,
        runId: claimed.id,
        slot,
        timeoutMs,
        now,
        ...(args.onReceiptFreeRecovery ? { onReceiptFreeRecovery: args.onReceiptFreeRecovery } : {}),
    })));
    const failures = settled.flatMap((result, index) => (result.status === 'rejected'
        ? [{
                slot: slots[index],
                error: result.reason instanceof Error ? result.reason.message : String(result.reason),
            }]
        : []));
    return {
        run: slots.length > 0 ? await args.client.getRun(claimed.id) : claimed,
        dispatched: slots,
        failures,
    };
};
export const waitForHostedDraftRun = async (args) => {
    const now = args.now ?? Date.now;
    const sleep = args.sleep
        ?? ((milliseconds) => new Promise((resolve) => { setTimeout(resolve, milliseconds); }));
    const deadline = now() + (args.timeoutMs ?? 30 * 60 * 1_000);
    let current = args.run;
    while (!hostedDraftRunIsSettled(current) && now() < deadline) {
        await sleep(args.pollIntervalMs ?? 5_000);
        current = await args.client.getRun(current.id);
        args.onProgress?.(current);
    }
    return current;
};
const sha256 = (bytes) => createHash('sha256').update(bytes).digest('hex');
const writeVerifiedImage = async (file, bytes, digest) => {
    const existing = await readFile(file).catch(() => null);
    if (existing) {
        if (sha256(existing) !== digest) {
            throw new Error(`Refusing to replace changed draft candidate ${file}`);
        }
        return;
    }
    await mkdir(path.dirname(file), { recursive: true });
    const temporary = path.join(path.dirname(file), `.${path.basename(file)}.${randomUUID()}.tmp`);
    try {
        await writeFile(temporary, bytes, { flag: 'wx', mode: 0o600 });
        await rename(temporary, file);
    }
    finally {
        await rm(temporary, { force: true });
    }
};
/** Download settled service images without overwriting a changed local artifact. */
export const downloadHostedDraftCandidates = async (args) => {
    const bySlot = new Map(args.run.candidates.map((candidate) => [candidate.slot, candidate]));
    return await Promise.all(args.candidates.flatMap((candidate) => {
        const state = bySlot.get(candidate.slot);
        if (state?.status !== 'succeeded')
            return [];
        return [async () => {
                const image = await args.client.downloadScreen(args.run.id, candidate.slot);
                const digest = sha256(image.bytes);
                if (digest !== image.sha256) {
                    throw new Error(`Hosted candidate ${candidate.slot} failed its download digest check`);
                }
                await writeVerifiedImage(candidate.outputPath, image.bytes, digest);
                return {
                    slot: candidate.slot,
                    path: candidate.outputPath,
                    sha256: digest,
                    bytes: image.bytes.byteLength,
                };
            }];
    }).map((download) => download()));
};

    // called.
    if (!entry && CONVERSION_ID.test(trimmed))
        return { kind: 'conversion', conversionId: trimmed };
    if (entry?.isFile()) {
        return { kind: 'unknown', given: trimmed, resolved };
    }
    if (entry?.isDirectory()) {

            return { kind: 'branch', directory: resolved };
        const branchDir = path.join(resolved, DRAFT_BRANCH_DIRECTORY);
        if (await holdsAny(branchDir, BRANCH_RECORDS))
            return { kind: 'branch', directory: branchDir };
        if (await exists(path.join(resolved, DRAFT_RECORD_FILENAME))) {
            return { kind: 'draft', directory: resolved };
        }
        // `12ui draft` claims its directory before it writes anything else; the
        // finished record above is checked first so a settled draft is unchanged.
        if (await exists(path.join(resolved, DRAFT_CLAIM_FILENAME))) {
            return { kind: 'draft', directory: resolved, claiming: true };
        }
        // Last, because every other record is more specific: a directory a command
        // wrote a journal into can still answer what that command is doing.
        if (await exists(path.join(resolved, RUN_JOURNAL_FILENAME))) {
            return { kind: 'workspace', directory: resolved };
        }
    }
    return {
        kind: 'unknown',
        given: trimmed,
        resolved,
        ...(entry?.isDirectory() ? { directory: resolved } : {}),
    };
};
/**
 * The durable directory a target's record lives in, for the run journal. A
 * hosted run has none — it is the service's, not this machine's.
 */
export const nextTargetWorkspace = (target) => {
    switch (target.kind) {
        case 'branch':
        case 'draft':
        case 'workspace':
            return target.directory;
        case 'unknown':
            return target.directory;
        default:
            return undefined;
    }

const readDraftItems = async (root, record) => {
    const draft = await readDraftRecord(path.join(root, DRAFT_RECORD_FILENAME));
    if (!draft)
        return { items: [] };
    const items = [];
    for (const candidate of draft.hosted.candidates) {
        if (!candidate.outputPath)
            continue;
        const media = await fileMedia(root, candidate.outputPath);
        if (!media)
            continue;
        items.push(attachStoredState({
            id: itemId('drafts', candidate.id, media.path),
            group: 'drafts',
            title: `Candidate ${candidate.id}`,
            detail: candidate.direction,
            media,
            editSource: {
                kind: 'draft',
                imagePath: media.path,
                mediaType: imageMediaType(media.path),
            },
            editQuote: reviewEditQuote({ conversions: 1, edits: 1 }),
        }, record));
    }
    return { label: draft.query, items };
};
const branchDirectoryOf = async (root) => {
    if (await exists(path.join(root, BRANCH_COMPLETION_FILENAME)))
        return root;
    const child = path.join(root, DRAFT_BRANCH_DIRECTORY);
    if (await exists(path.join(child, BRANCH_COMPLETION_FILENAME)))
        return child;
    return null;
};

import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
import { closeSync, existsSync, openSync, writeSync } from 'node:fs';
import { readFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
import path from 'node:path';
import { CLI_BOOLEAN_FLAGS } from './cli-arguments.js';
import { isCliRefusal } from './cli-refusal.js';
import { HostedDraftFailureError } from './hosted-draft-run.js';
/**
 * The CLI run journal — the durable record of what the CLI actually did.
 *
 * WHY THIS EXISTS. The product left a one-request shell transcript: `12ui draft`
 * collapsed three commands into one, branch execution orchestrates several
 * server-side stages, and a fused convert exports alongside itself. Every measurement pass since has
 * made the same mistake in a new costume — the absence of a command in a shell
 * transcript was read as the absence of work. It is not: the work moved into
 * the CLI, and the shell stopped being able to see it. So the CLI writes down
 * what it did, in the workspace the work belongs to, and that record — not a
 * transcript, not narration — is what a reader scores.
 *
 * WHERE. `<workspace>/journal.jsonl`, one JSON object per line, where the
 * workspace is the durable directory the command operates on: a draft run
 * directory, a branch out-dir, a convert or export output directory. Commands
 * with no workspace (`auth status`, `capabilities`, `create claim`, `mcp`) do
 * not journal — see `run-journal-commands.ts`, which enumerates the whole
 * surface and states a reason for every command that skips.
 *
 * ORDER AND DURABILITY.
 * - Append-only. A line, once written, is never rewritten or removed.
 * - Every append is ONE `write(2)` of a complete line under
 *   {@link RUN_JOURNAL_MAX_LINE_BYTES} to a descriptor opened `O_APPEND`, so
 *   concurrent CLI processes observing or resuming one workspace never
 *   interleave 

FILE versions/0.2.130/node_modules/@12ui/design/dist/slate-brand.js
policy asked to keep its image's typefaces (`--retain font`): the brand's `font` fact. */
export const draftBrandFont = (retain) => (isRecord(retain) && Array.isArray(retain.include) && retain.include.includes('typography'));
/**
 * Whether a brand's options set their headings in the brand image's typefaces: kept as `style` (its whole visual
 * style), or asked for (`font`). A brand recorded before the font fact existed (no `font`) keeps its typefaces, as it
 * always did, so a workspace opened before keeps drawing as it began.
 */
export const brandKeepsFont = (brand) => (brand.retain === 'style' || brand.font !== false);
/**
 * The brand a new local workspace takes from its draft record (`draft.json`, read as untrusted JSON), or null. A record
 * that declares a brand whose kept file is missing, outside the run or no longer its bytes is refused by name rather
 * than opened without the brand the person asked for.
 */
export const readDraftBrand = async (root, draft) => {
    if (!isRecord(draft))
        return null;
    const retain = draftBrandRetain(draft.retain);
    const source = isRecord(draft.redesignSource) ? draft.redesignSource : null;
    if (!retain || !source || source.file === undefined)
        return null;
    const draftFile = path.join(root, 'draft.json');
    const file = source.file;
    const sha256 = source.sha256;
    if (typeof file !== 'string' || !DRAFT_REFERENCE_FILE_PATTERN.test(file) || typeof sha256 !== 'string'
        || !SHA256_PATTERN.test(sha256) || !file.startsWith(`reference/${sha256}.`)) {
        throw new SlateStateInvalidError(draftFile, 'redesignSource.file is not the run\'s own reference/<sha256> image');
    }
    const read = await readWorkspaceFile(root, path.join(root, file));
    if (read.state !== 'ok' || read.sha256 !== sha256) {
        throw new SlateStateInvalidError(draftFile, `names the brand reference ${file}, which is missing or no longer its bytes`);
    }
    const { width, height } = await readImageDimensions(read.bytes);
    return { file, sha256, retain, font: draftBrandFont(draft.retain), width, height };
};

/** The brand image's bytes for a draw or the screen, checked against the digest the workspace recorded. */
export const readBrandBytes = async (root, brand) => {
    const read = await readWorkspaceFile(root, path.join(root, brand.file));
    if (read.state !== 'ok' || read.sha256 !== brand.sha256) {
        throw new SlateError('file_changed', 'The brand reference image in this run is missing or changed.', { l10n: { code: 'file_changed' } });
    }
    return read.bytes;
};

FILE versions/0.2.130/node_modules/@12ui/design/dist/slate-round-queries.js
import path from 'node:path';
import { readDraftRecord } from './draft-workspace.js';
const rootCorpusQuery = async (root) => {
    const record = await readDraftRecord(path.join(root, 'draft.json'));
    if (typeof record !== 'object' || record === null)
        return null;
    const corpus = record.corpus;
    if (typeof corpus !== 'object' || corpus === null)
        return null;
    const query = corpus.query;
    return typeof query === 'string' && query.trim() ? query.trim() : null;
};
export const readRoundQueries = async (root, workspace) => {
    const out = [];
    for (const round of [...workspace.rounds].sort((a, b) => a.index - b.index)) {
        let query = null;
        if (round.referenceSource === 'root') {
            query = await rootCorpusQuery(root);
        }
        else if (round.referenceSource === 'search') {
            const op = workspace.ops.find((entry) => entry.params.kind === 'round' && entry.params.roundId === round.roundId);
            query = op && op.params.kind === 'round' && op.params.concept.trim() ? op.params.concept.trim() : null;
        }
        if (query)
            out.push({ roundIndex: round.index, query });
    }
    return out;
};

/** What `draft.json` says about the root, read defensively: a fixture may hold only a few fields. */
const readRootFacts = async (root) => {
    const record = await readDraftRecord(path.join(root, 'draft.json'));
    const draft = isRecord(record) ? record : {};
    const aspect = draft.aspect === 'portrait' || draft.aspect === 'square' ? draft.aspect : 'landscape';
    const hosted = isRecord(draft.hosted) ? draft.hosted : {};
    const corpus = isRecord(draft.corpus) ? draft.corpus : {};
    const candidates = Array.isArray(hosted.candidates) ? hosted.candidates : [];
    const references = Array.isArray(corpus.references) ? corpus.references : [];
    const referenceBySlot = new Map();
    for (const entry of candidates) {
        if (!isRecord(entry))
            continue;
        const slot = text(entry.slot);
        const referenceId = text(entry.referenceId);
        if (slot && referenceId && REFERENCE_ID_PATTERN.test(referenceId))
            referenceBySlot.set(slot.toLowerCase(), referenceId);
    }
    const aspectByReference = new Map();
    for (const entry of references) {
        if (isRecord(entry) && typeof entry.id === 'string')
            aspectByReference.set(entry.id, referenceAspect(entry.aspect));
    }
    return { concept: text(draft.query) ?? '', aspect, createdAt: text(draft.createdAt), referenceBySlot, aspectByReference, draft };
};
